notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.77.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Nut "Ghi ky hieu HM": hang muc con chua co moc MocDinhViHMuc_Links thi addin tu tao moc moi tai goc duong ranh cua hang muc (uu tien goc nam tren truc, chua co moc), khong lay bot 3 moc dinh vi cua nha chinh. - Moc chua co ky hieu thuoc ve hang muc co goc duong ranh trung vi tri moc. Dinh hang muc duoc ghi cho moi moc cung ky hieu. - Moc nam tren truc thi lay ten truc do; nam giua 2 truc thi lay ten 2 truc ke hai ben, vi du "13-C,C'". - Bo quy tac cu "cach giao diem qua 500 mm thi giu nguyen ten".
